post.text: My first job at age 15 was a clerk at Gamestop. The managers were neckbeard chuds. I wore a short skirt to the interview and told them I played World of Warcraft. They hired me on the spot. https://t.co/rAWwosJVYa

referenced_tweet_data.text: She's back, and so are the classics. https://t.co/RKrn5AZ9GR

description.description: A close-up of a GameStop female employee standing at the video game store.

quotedTweetMedia.transcription: Hey, I'm Riley, and welcome back to GameStop. As you can see, some things have changed. Thanks to all your trade-ins, GameStop Retro has essentially expanded to all stores nationwide. That means no matter what GameStop location you visit, you can dive right back into your childhood. I love it! You'll find a growing selection of classic games and consoles, like the GameCube, the GameWatch, the Wii, and more. Feel old yet? Retro games are a great way to relive the characters and stories that became core memories. You swore you'd beat that final boss one day. Why not now? Thanks for stopping by GameStop. See you later.
